about: Narrator voices designed with Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign (Apache-2.0); synthetic, not modelled on any real person. Rebuild with scripts/build_voice_library.py.
text: Hi there. In this short walkthrough, I'll show you what changed, why it matters, and how it looks on screen. It only takes a few minutes, so let's get started.

nora.label: Nora: American woman, 30s, warm and clear product guide
nora.description: A woman in her early thirties with a warm, clear American voice. She speaks at a natural conversational pace, friendly and confident, like a product guide showing a colleague around. Even tone, no sales pitch, no exaggerated emphasis.

james.label: James: American man, 30s, relaxed and conversational
james.description: A man in his thirties with a relaxed, natural American voice and a mid-range tone. He speaks at a normal conversational pace, calm and easy, like explaining something to a friend. Plain delivery, no excitement, no drawn-out words.

olivia.label: Olivia: British woman, 30s, calm and polished presenter
olivia.description: A woman in her thirties with a calm, polished British voice. She speaks clearly at an even, unhurried but natural pace, like a professional presenter. Understated and confident, never theatrical.

henry.label: Henry: British man, 40s, steady and trustworthy
henry.description: A man in his forties with a steady, warm British voice and a slightly low register. He speaks at a measured, natural pace with quiet confidence, like a trusted advisor. Plain delivery, no drama.

priya.label: Priya: Indian English woman, 30s, bright and clear explainer
priya.description: A woman in her thirties with a clear Indian English accent and a bright, friendly mid-range voice. She speaks at a natural, steady pace, articulate and approachable, like a teacher explaining something simply. No exaggerated emphasis.

marcus.label: Marcus: American man, 40s, deep and assured (B2B)
marcus.description: A man in his forties with a deep, smooth American voice. He speaks at a calm, natural pace with quiet authority, like a narrator for an enterprise software video. Even, assured delivery, no hype.

ethan.label: Ethan: American man, late 20s, bright and friendly (launches)
ethan.description: A man in his late twenties with a bright, friendly American voice. He speaks at a lively but natural conversational pace, upbeat without sounding like an advert, like a founder showing off something he built. Clear, never shouty, no drawn-out words.

graham.label: Graham: British man, early 50s, veteran analyst (finance, research, B2B)
graham.description: British man in his early fifties, a veteran City fund analyst. Deep, slightly gravelly voice, unhurried and dry, quietly confident. Plain delivery at a natural pace, no sales pitch, no drawn-out words.

claire.label: Claire: American woman, mid 40s, senior strategist (finance, data, briefings)
claire.description: American woman in her mid forties, a senior market strategist. Rich, low alto, crisp and composed, assured and warm. Even, natural pace, like briefing a client, no exaggerated emphasis.
